Receipt image shows 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' then 'Rounding Adj: -0.01' and 'TOTAL: 23.25' — final total after rounding is 23.25, not 23.26. Agent picked the pre-rounding Total line."},{"id":"F4","description":"Receipt 034.jpg date wrong (predicted 2018-08-09; marked incorrect).","evidence":"field_feedback: 034.jpg date_correct=false. Receipt image shows 'Date: 09/03/2018' (DD/MM/YYYY → 2018-03-09). Agent likely parsed as MM/DD or swapped day/month."},{"id":"F5","description":"Agent spent many iterations debugging a single difficult receipt (078) and still failed, hitting max_iterations=65 termination.","evidence":"execution_metadata.termination_reason=max_iterations; response_tool_call_counts shows 27 terminal + 22 think + 16 file_editor; trajectory shows repeated OCR variant exploration without a cheap pre-committed strategy."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"R1","description":"Rounding-adjustment handling missing: when a receipt shows an un-rounded 'Total' followed by 'Rounding Adj' and a final 'TOTAL' (or 'Total After Rounding' / 'Total Rounded'), the final rounded value must win. Current logic takes the first/priority keyword match and ignores downstream rounded totals.","supports":["F3"]},{"id":"R2","description":"Date parsing is ambiguous for DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY. The current DATE_PATTERNS list in the candidate skill tries '%d-%m-%Y' before '%m-%d-%Y' but does not use locale/receipt-origin hints and does not sanity-check against plausible day/month ranges beyond year. For '09/03/2018' both parses are valid (Mar 9 vs Sep 3) and the chosen fallback was wrong.","supports":["F4"]},{"id":"R3","description":"Keyword-matching stops at generic 'Total' line even when a more specific 'Grand Total' / 'Total Rounded' / 'Net Total' appears later in the receipt summary block. Priority tiers are respected across keywords but within a single tier (or across close synonyms), later/more-specific summary lines are not preferred.","supports":["F2","F3"]},{"id":"R4","description":"OCR robustness for faded / low-contrast receipts is limited by the fixed small set of preprocessing variants and PSM modes. Receipts like 078 require 3x upscaling with PSM 4 which is not always in the default variant set; added only after many debugging iterations.","supports":["F1","F5"]},{"id":"R5","description":"Noisy OCR of keyword tokens ('GrandTota.', 'Grand Tota.', 'a Total') is not matched by strict `\\bGRAND\\s+TOTAL\\b` regex. No fuzzy / punctuation-tolerant keyword matching exists.","supports":["F1"]},{"id":"R6","description":"No budgeted per-image strategy: the agent re-tries many variants ad-hoc per hard image, consuming iterations rather than running a fixed cheap pipeline + one escalated fallback.","supports":["F5"]}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Priority logic takes first keyword match in a tier without preferring the final rounded total line. Does not model the receipt summary pattern 'Total → Rounding Adj → Final TOTAL / Total Rounded / Total After Rounding / Net Total'.","root_causes":["R1","R3"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date extraction patterns are ordered but there is no explicit rule or guidance for disambiguating DD/MM vs MM/DD, and no cross-check (e.g., prefer DD/MM when day>12 appears elsewhere, or when currency/locale suggests MY/SG).","root_causes":["R2"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Keyword regexes require exact word boundaries and whitespace; they fail on common OCR corruptions like 'GrandTotal', 'Grand Tota.', 'TotaI', 'T0TAL'. No normalization step (collapse spaces, strip punctuation, OCR-confusion substitutions) is applied to the matching layer.","root_causes":["R5"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Preprocessing/variant set is narrow and fixed. No systematic escalation ladder (e.g., default → autocontrast → 2x upscale → 3x upscale + PSM 4 → inverted) tied to a vote across variants.","root_causes":["R4"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No explicit guidance to collect ALL numeric candidates from the summary block and apply tie-breaking rules (prefer rounded, prefer line labeled Grand/Net/Final, prefer last total-labeled line before payment lines).","root_causes":["R1","R3"]},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"No per-image compute budget guidance; batch pipeline example does not cap variants or short-circuit when a high-confidence match is found, encouraging unbounded exploration.","root_causes":["R6"]},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No explicit reminder that currency-like string columns (e.g., total_amount formatted as '47.70') must remain object dtype through write; while the candidate image-ocr already notes this, cross-skill guidance in xlsx is silent on preserving pre-formatted numeric strings during pandas→Excel export.","root_causes":["R1"]}],"repair_recommendations":[{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Summary-block aware total selection' rule: after keyword matching, scan a trailing window of up to ~10 lines following the first total-keyword hit for lines matching 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING', 'NET TOTAL', 'GRAND TOTAL', or 'TOTAL' that appear AFTER a 'ROUNDING ADJ' / 'ROUNDING' line, and prefer that value. Document pattern: 'Total → Rounding Adj → Final rounded TOTAL wins.'","addresses":["R1","R3"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Augment PRIORITY_TIERS with a new highest-priority tier for post-rounding totals: ['TOTAL ROUNDED','TOTAL AFTER ROUNDING','ROUNDED TOTAL','TOTAL (INCL. OF GST)' only when followed by 'TOTAL RM' later]. Note explicitly that generic 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' is NOT final when a later 'TOTAL' line exists after 'Rounding Adj'.","addresses":["R1","R3"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a fuzzy/normalized keyword matcher: before regex, normalize the OCR line by uppercasing, removing non-alphanumeric chars, collapsing whitespace, and applying common OCR substitutions (0↔O, 1↔I/l, 5↔S). Match against normalized keywords like 'GRANDTOTAL','TOTAL','TOTALRM','NETTOTAL','TOTALROUNDED'. Keep the original line for number extraction.","addresses":["R5"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Introduce a documented preprocessing escalation ladder with voting: (1) default, (2) grayscale+autocontrast PSM 6, (3) 2x upscale autocontrast PSM 6, (4) 3x upscale autocontrast PSM 4, (5) inverted autocontrast PSM 6. Collect total candidates from each variant, then majority-vote; break ties by priority tier, then by presence of two-decimal format.","addresses":["R4","R6"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add date-disambiguation guidance: when a date matches both DD/MM/YYYY and MM/DD/YYYY, default to DD/MM/YYYY for receipts (common in MY/SG/UK locales shown in task examples: 'RM', 'GST', 'SST'). Add a check: if any date on the receipt has day>12 in position 1, lock DD/MM for all dates on that receipt.","addresses":["R2"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Expand EXCLUSION keywords and header-line detection: add 'SERV. CHARGE', 'SERVICE CHARGE', 'TOTAL (EXCLUDING GST)', 'TOTAL EXCL', 'AMT EXCL GST', 'SUB TOTAL (GST)', 'TOTAL SALES', 'TOTAL SAVINGS', 'AVERAGE', 'PAX', 'POINTS', 'BALANCE', 'DEPOSIT'. Document that column-header lines ('Description Qty Price Amount', 'QTY PRICE AMOUNT') must be excluded.","addresses":["R1","R3"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a per-image budget note and short-circuit rule: 'Run the escalation ladder in order; stop as soon as two variants agree on a (date, total) pair, or after the full ladder completes. Do not spend more than ~5 OCR passes per image.' This generalizes to prevent iteration-budget exhaustion.","addresses":["R6"]},{"target_skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add an explicit worked example in the skill for the 'Total → Rounding Adj → TOTAL' pattern and for the DD/MM vs MM/DD ambiguity, so future runs encode the rule without re-deriving it.","addresses":["R1","R2","R3"]},{"target_skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short note under 'Working with pandas' that pre-formatted monetary strings (e.g., '47.70') must be written with object dtype and that `pd.ExcelWriter` with openpyxl preserves strings; warn against passing floats when the schema requires a fixed-decimal string.","addresses":["R1"]}],"confidence":{"observed_failures":"high","root_causes":"medium-high","skill_defects":"medium-high","repair_recommendations":"medium","notes":"Failures F3 and F4 are directly readable from the supplied receipt images (23.25 vs 23.26; 09/03/2018 as DD/MM). F1 is corroborated by trajectory OCR traces. F2 (074.jpg) cause is inferred from the general pattern but exact winning line not confirmed from this window; recommendations are general enough to cover it."}}
